# origincloud_network_internet_gateway (Resource)

A VPC's way to and from the internet.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project the internet gateway is in. Changing it replaces the internet gateway.
- `region` (String) The region the internet gateway is in. Changing it replaces the internet gateway.
- `vpc` (String) The full name of the VPC the gateway connects, in the same project and region. Changing it replaces the internet gateway.

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the internet gateway was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the internet gateway, by its full name on iam: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/users/{user}`, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`, or a platform service agent's or service's name when the platform did.
- `id` (String) The internet gateway's full resource name, `//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/internetGateways/{internet_gateway}`: what an argument that refers to the internet gateway takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The gateway's resource name.
